On this day in 2010, Jamail Amron called 911, asked for help, and died handcuffed under the foot of a Harris County constable. 

Mr. Amron's family received a settlement from the county but no charges have been brought against any of the officers involved. #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/o8JyPFoeaN

On this day in 2019, Atatiana Jefferson was murdered by a Fort Worth police officer while inside her own home. His trial is set for Nov. 16.

The fight for accountability and justice continues. #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/FGxYbbslMS
